sentences.text: Samuel Henry John Worthington -LRB- born 2 August 1976 -RRB- is a British-born Australian actor .	actor	actor
He played the main character role of Alex Mason in the Call of Duty : Black Ops series .

He portrayed the protagonist Jake Sully in the 2009 film Avatar ; Marcus Wright in Terminator Salvation ; and Perseus in Clash of the Titans and its sequel , Wrath of the Titans ; before transitioning to more dramatic roles , in Everest -LRB- 2015 -RRB- and Hacksaw Ridge -LRB- 2016 -RRB- .	protagonist	protagonist	Avatar	Avatar (2009 film)	Terminator Salvation	Terminator Salvation	Perseus	Perseus	Clash of the Titans	Clash of the Titans (2010 film)	Wrath of the Titans	Wrath of the Titans	Everest	Everest (2015 film)	Hacksaw Ridge	Hacksaw Ridge
In 2004 , Worthington received Australia 's highest film award for his lead role in Somersault .	Somersault	Somersault (film)
He performed predominantly in leading roles in a variety of low-budget films before moving to major studio films , ranging from romantic drama and comedy-drama to science fiction and action .
